description: Every forward stage is contained in the finite support of its Horn theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage_support.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage Γ n ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.support Γ
